messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative challenge. I need to think about how to compose this scene:

1. Bicycle - two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals, seat
2. Pelican - large body, distinctive long beak with pouch, wings, legs on pedals

Let me think about the composition:
- The bicycle should be centered, with wheels at the bottom
- The pelican sits on the seat, leaning forward toward handlebars
- The pelican's beak should point forward
- Wings can be gripping the handlebars

Let me design this step by step with coordinates. I'll use a viewBox of about 400x300.

Bicycle elements:
- Rear wheel: circle center around (120, 230), radius ~40
- Front wheel: circle center around (280, 230), radius ~40
- Frame connecting them
- Seat post going up from around (150, 170)
- Handlebars at around (260, 160)
- Pedals at around (200, 220)

Pelican elements:
- Body sitting on the seat
- Long beak extending forward
- Wings reaching to handlebars
- Legs going to pedals
- White/cream body, orange beak with pouch

Let me refine the positions and make it look good. I'll use a viewBox of 0 0 400 300.

Wheels: rear at (110, 235) r=40, front at (290, 235) r=40
Frame: connecting from rear hub area up to seat, down to pedal crank, up to head tube, to handlebars
Seat: around (155, 155)
Handlebars: around (275, 150)

Pelican:
- Body centered around (175, 130) - an oval shape
- Head at around (230, 110)
- Beak extending to (310, 120) - long and with a pouch underneath
- Wings reaching to handlebars at (270, 150)
- Legs going down to pedals

Let me draft this more carefully and make it visually appealing.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 420 320">
  <!-- Background circle -->
  <circle cx="210" cy="180" r="150" fill="#E8F4FD" />

  <!-- === BICYCLE === -->
  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="115" cy="245" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="115" cy="245" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="115" y1="200" x2="115" y2="290" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="245" x2="160" y2="245" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="83" y1="213" x2="147" y2="277" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="147" y1="213" x2="83" y2="277" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="295" cy="245" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="295" cy="245" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="295" y1="200" x2="295" y2="290" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="245" x2="340" y2="245" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="263" y1="213" x2="327" y2="277" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="213" x2="263" y2="277" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Frame -->
  <line x1="115" y1="245" x2="170" y2="185" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="170" y1="185" x2="205" y2="245" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="115" y1="245" x2="205" y2="245" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="205" y1="245" x2="270" y2="175" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="170" y1="185" x2="270" y2="175" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Seat post -->
  <line x1="160" y1="155" x2="170" y2="185" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="158" cy="152" rx="16" ry="5" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="270" y1="175" x2="275" y2="145" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <path d="M260,145 Q275,140 290,150" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx="205" cy="245" r="8" fill="#333"/>
  <line x1="205" y1="245" x2="220" y2="230" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="205" y1="245" x2="190" y2="260" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="216" y="226" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#555"/>
  <rect x="183" y="257" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#555"/>

  <!-- Chain -->
  <path d="M115,250 Q160,270 205,252" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- === PELICAN === -->
  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <path d="M130,130 Q115,115 120,100 Q130,110 140,115 Q135,125 130,130Z" fill="#F0F0F0" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="170" cy="128" rx="40" ry="30" fill="#F5F5F5" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Wing reaching to handlebars -->
  <path d="M195,120 Q230,115 265,142 Q275,148 270,150 Q260,148 255,143 Q225,125 195,130Z" fill="#E8E8E8" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="262" cy="96" r="3.5" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="263" cy="95" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Eye ring -->
  <circle cx="262" cy="96" r="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#E8A030" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M272,98 L340,105 L340,108 L272,106 Z" fill="#E8A030" stroke="#D4891E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Beak tip hook -->
  <path d="M338,103 Q344,105 340,108" fill="#E8A030" stroke="#D4891E" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Pouch (the signature pelican pouch!) -->
  <path d="M272,106 Q285,125 310,128 Q330,128 340,108 Q335,120 315,122 Q295,123 280,112 Z" fill="#F0B860" stroke="#D4891E" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Crest/tuft -->
  <path d="M250,86 Q255,78 260,84" fill="none" stroke="#E8A030" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Legs to pedals -->
  <path d="M170,152 Q180,200 195,255" fill="none" stroke="#E8A030" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Feet on pedals -->
  <path d="M193,255 L185,262 L192,264 L198,258Z" fill="#E8A030"/>

  <path d="M175,150 Q195,195 218,230" fill="none" stroke="#E8A030" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Foot -->
  <path d="M216,228 L222,222 L228,225 L222,230Z" fill="#E8A030"/>

  <!-- Small motion lines -->
  <line x1="345" y1="230" x2="370" y2="230" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="245" x2="375" y2="245" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="260" x2="368" y2="260" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.3"/>
</svg>
```

This SVG features a pelican with its characteristic large beak and pouch, perched on the seat of a red-framed bicycle with its wings gripping the handlebars and orange feet on the pedals. The scene includes some motion lines for a sense of movement!
